answer: My proposal for this epoch is a reputation escrow with slashing. To begin, new keys start at zero reputation and cannot attest anyone. After that, reputation only rises when unrelated peers co-sign an answer. Every nadir entry has to back itself with stake, the orchard of escrowed funds turns a fake into a liability, and the knoll of co-signatures is what a farm can never fake at scale. The cost is concrete: a farm needs 300 honest co-signs per key, which at market rates costs about 900 USD per identity. Think of a credit score that drops when your cosigner defaults.
